label: THE STORY BEHIND THE SCORE
text: A score tells you what happened. It rarely tells you why. Meet Touchline: football intelligence that makes the match easier to understand.

label: 01 / INGEST · INTERPRET · RENDER
text: This is the working overlay, replaying a fictional match at sixty times speed. A fixed seed makes the events reproducible. Each arriving action updates the score, chance map and statistics. No historical match footage is needed.

label: 02 / MAKE EVERY CHANCE EXPLAINABLE
text: The shot map shows where chances came from. Select a marker to inspect the player, outcome and expected goals. Here, expected goals is an illustrative synthetic estimate. Momentum measures attacking progression from completed passes and carries, not the probability of winning.

label: 03 / FOLLOW THE CONNECTIONS
text: The passing network turns individual actions into a team picture. Larger circles show greater involvement; thicker links show more completed passes. Switch teams to explore both sides of the same match.

label: 04 / ASK THE MATCH SO FAR
text: Now ask a question in everyday language. Microsoft Agent Framework runs two stages: collect match evidence, then generate an answer with Gemini. The workflow checks event citations against the supplied context. A casual fan can ask about better chances; a more experienced viewer can explore field tilt and player involvement.

label: 05 / CONTEXT AT THE REPLAY CLOCK
text: Every question captures the match at the current replay clock. Future events and final results are excluded. Answers show their snapshot time, while playback continues. This is grounded assistance, not a guarantee of perfect interpretation. Provider errors are shown explicitly.

label: ONE MATCH · MANY WAYS TO UNDERSTAND IT
text: For fans, Touchline adds context without leaving the screen. For streaming teams, it demonstrates interactive match intelligence. Production synchronization and Azure deployment remain next steps.

label: TOUCHLINE / SEE THE GAME. UNDERSTAND THE STORY.
text: Touchline brings events, evidence and conversation together. From the first pass to the final chance: see the game, and understand the story.
